name: codesextant
description: CodeSextant: a cross-language code map plus spec-conformance checking. Rewritten fully in TypeScript, with language-specific precision engines demoted to optional add-ons. A read-only navigation map: it reads reference relationships and structure, never edits code, and offers leads rather than decisions.
//: Dependency versions are estimates, corrected against whatever is actually available at the first P0 npm install (the web-tree-sitter API differs between 0.20 and 0.25 in particular, and was pinned down during the PoC). Language precision add-ons, such as the codesextant-python jedi bridge, are optional and are not listed as core dependencies.
